**Sensitivity Indices for Philanthropic Cost per DALY (Campaign + Registry)**

Regression-based sensitivity showing which inputs explain the most variance in the output.

| Input Parameter | Sensitivity Coefficient | Interpretation |
|:----------------|------------------------:|:---------------|
| Annual Experimental Treatment Center Patients (50-State) (patients/year) | -0.3864 | Moderate driver |
| National Outcome Registry Annual Operating Cost (USD/year) | 0.3560 | Moderate driver |
| Annual DALY Gain per Patient on an Eventually-Effective Treatment (DALYs) | -0.3421 | Moderate driver |
| Regulatory Delay for Efficacy Testing Post-Safety Verification (years) | -0.2097 | Weak driver |
| Pharma Drug Success Rate (Current System) (percentage) | -0.1623 | Weak driver |
| Total 49-State Campaign Cost (USD) | 0.1121 | Weak driver |
| Philanthropic Registry Funding Horizon (years) | -0.0518 | Minimal effect |

*Interpretation*: Standardized coefficients show the change in output (in SD units) per 1 SD change in input. Values near ±1 indicate strong influence; values exceeding ±1 may occur with correlated inputs.
